name: m4-closed-typeref-kperf
description: As m4-closed-fast2-kperf with retronym/scala#243 under all three builds: with `NonClassTypeRef` a class, `relativeInfo`'s cache fields are field loads, not megamorphic interface accessors. How much of the closed-scope overhead was those itable stubs? PMU profile, kperf, one fork per variant, 15 + 3 single shots, typer only. Not a timing A/B.
